purpose: Validate on new independent data whether a preregistered tip-dx-targeted defensive-mixture importance proposal repairs the lower-tail Bayes ESS failure observed in Phase 0.5 without changing the physical model, likelihood, legal observations, safety rules, labels, or ESS thresholds.

exploratory_evidence_used_to_select_prop.selection_data: the already observed Phase 0.5 confirmatory held-out set
exploratory_evidence_used_to_select_prop.important_limitation: The exploratory data used to choose this proposal cannot be reused to validate it.

proposal.kernel: Gaussian similarity kernel over noiseless particle mean tip_dx relative to the current observation
proposal.target_distribution: original frozen class-conditional safe paired identification prior

bayes_validation.likelihood: exact Gaussian observation likelihood under the frozen simulator noise model
bayes_validation.evaluation_set: new Phase 0.5b held-out compliant test records only

mandatory_comparisons: uniform proposal ESS on the new held-out set
targeted proposal ESS on the same new held-out set

success_definition.primary: The preregistered targeted proposal passes the frozen ESS p05 and median thresholds for both classes on the new independent held-out set.
success_definition.secondary: Targeted-proposal Bayes ROC-AUC remains statistically consistent with the underlying Phase 0.5 identification signal rather than showing evidence of estimator distortion.

invalid_run_conditions: validation dataset seed changed after results are inspected
split seed changed after results are inspected
particle seed changed after results are inspected
proposal alpha changed after results are inspected
proposal tau changed after results are inspected
ESS threshold changed after results are inspected
old Phase 0.5 confirmatory held-out records reused for validation
privileged hidden field used as legal observation
